The name Rasmi carries the meaning “Ambrosia, Essence, Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rasmi usually hope their child will grow to embody ambrosia, essence, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
